messages.text: Hi! I finished reading Gatsby early. Could I write the essay on a different theme than the prompt?
Love that you're ahead. Which theme are you thinking about?
The green light as a symbol of the American Dream, and how its meaning changes by the end of the book.
Hi Amir, I saw the quadratic equations worksheet was a tough one. Want to go over it together?
Yes please. I mixed up the formula on questions 4 and 5.
No problem. I'm in B-204 at lunch on Monday and Wednesday. Bring the worksheet and we'll work through them.
Thanks for Monday, that helped a lot.
Is the polynomial functions quiz on Thursday open book?
For the development environment setup, should we install Python 3.12 or 3.13?
3.12 is fine, it's what the lab machines run. The setup guide in the class folder walks through each step.
Got it working. Thanks!
For the Newton's laws lab report, do the force vs. acceleration graphs need error bars?
Yes, add error bars from your three trials using the standard deviation.
Okay, will do.
Hi, I've had a family situation this week. Could I get two extra days on the Gatsby essay?
I'm sorry to hear that, Ali. Yes, you can hand it in by Sunday, Nov 29. Let me know if you need anything else.
Thank you so much, I really appreciate it.
Hi Ethan, you've missed a few classes recently and I want to make sure you're okay. Can we find a time to talk this week?
Just checking in again. The Silk Road research project is still open if you'd like to hand it in late.
I was sick for the forces quiz review. Can I still take the quiz on Monday?
Of course. I'll leave the review notes on your desk tomorrow. Feel better!
Hi Ravi, I didn't see you in World History on Friday. Is everything alright? The primary sources worksheet is due Saturday.
